svg.text: VGA adapter: 256 colours, with 64-colour fallback (9 colour resistors)
5x7 cm perfboard (18 x 24 holes). Top view, component side, antenna end at the top.
pin header 1x14, wires to the VGA socket
solder bridge between neighbouring holes, on the underside
insulated ground wire, on the underside (the only wire on the board)
Each colour has three resistors joined at their left ends: 510 Ω on the top bit, 1 kΩ on the middle bit, 2 kΩ on the low bit.
256 colours: red 3 bits, green 3 bits, blue 2 bits. 64 colours: 2 bits per colour. The spare low pin of a colour repeats its top bit.
The rows of GPIO3 and GPIO46 stay empty. The right socket strip is drawn 10 holes from the left one; if your board is 9 apart, use column 16.
Pin names follow the ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 layout. Compare them with the labels printed on your board before soldering.
